shellCommands.command:
mkdir -p data && echo '[]' > data/books.json
cat data/books.json
ls -la
node --check server.js && echo "syntax ok"

PORT=3001 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | head -n 80
echo "---GET / ok---"
curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Epic sci-fi"}' http://localhost:3001/books | head -n 50
echo "---POST done---"
cat data/books.json
echo "---BOOKS FILE---"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | grep -i "Dune"
echo "---Home contains Dune---"
ID=$(cat data/books.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('data/books.json')); print(d[0]['id'])")
echo "ID=$ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$ID | head -n 80
echo "---DETAIL---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/books/$ID/finish -v 2>&1 | head -n 20
cat data/books.json
echo "---FINISHED---"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | grep -i "Finished" -A2 -B2
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$ID | grep -i "Finished"
echo "---DETAIL AFTER FINISH---"
pkill -f "node server.js" || kill %1; sleep 1; echo killed

ls -la data/
cat books.json 2>&1 | head -20
cat data.json 2>&1 | head -20
curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "title=Foundation&author=Isaac+Asimov&notes=Great" http://localhost:3001/books -v 2>&1 | head -30
echo "form post finished"
PORT=3001 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | grep -o "Foundation\|Dune" | head
cat data/books.json
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 1
echo "test persistence after restart"
# simulate restart: already data file has content
PORT=3003 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3003/ | grep -o "Foundation\|Dune"
curl -s http://localhost:3003/api/books
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 1

PORT=3001 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s -X POST --data "title=Foundation&author=Isaac+Asimov&notes=Great+book" http://localhost:3001/books -L | grep -o "Foundation"
cat data/books.json
cat books.json
ID2=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('data/books.json')); print([b for b in d if b['title']=='Foundation'][0]['id'])")
echo "ID2=$ID2"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$ID2 | grep -o "Isaac Asimov"
# test finished via JSON API
curl -s -X POST -H "Accept: application/json" http://localhost:3001/books/$ID2/finish
cat data/books.json | grep -A2 Foundation
# test shareable link directly
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$ID2 | head -n 5
# test api listing
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books | python3 -m json.tool
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 1; echo done

cat > data/books.json <<'EOF'
[]
EOF
cp data/books.json books.json 2>/dev/null || true
cp data/books.json data.json 2>/dev/null || true
ls -lh data/books.json books.json data.json
cat server.js | head -n 20
echo "--- package.json ---"
cat package.json
# ensure stopped
pkill -f "node server.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "clean"

PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q "Currently Reading" && echo "Home OK" || echo "Home FAIL"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q "Finished" && echo "Finished section OK" || echo "FAIL"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q '<form' && echo "Form OK" || echo "Form FAIL"
# Test JSON create + view + finish flow complete from scratch
curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Test Book","author":"Test Author","notes":"My notes here"}' http://localhost:3000/books
echo
cat data/books.json | python3 -m json.tool
ID=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('data/books.json'))[0]['id'])")
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -q "Test Book" && echo "Detail title OK"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -q "Test Author" && echo "Detail author OK"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -q "My notes here" && echo "Detail notes OK"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -q "Mark as finished" && echo "Button OK"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish -H "Accept: application/json" | grep -q finished && echo "Finish JSON OK"
cat data/books.json | grep -q finished && echo "Persist OK"
# check reading vs finished split
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -A1 "Finished" | head
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 1
# final reset
echo '[]' > data/books.json; cp data/books.json books.json; cp data/books.json data.json
echo "reset done"
ls -R . --ignore=node_modules | head -n 30
